stem: Which sentence from the letter shows that Katie has considered an opposing viewpoint?

options.label: F
options.text: As I'm sure you know, composting turns kitchen and yard waste into something usable once it is added to soil.

options.label: G
options.text: A chemical reaction happens when things like grass clippings, orange peels, and newspapers are layered in a certain way.

options.label: H
options.text: As president of the Truman Middle School Beautification Club, I am very concerned about the environment.

options.label: J
options.text: And yes, if not properly maintained, a compost pile can smell bad and attract pests.
